en.name: Professor
en.ability: Once per game, at night*, choose a dead player: if they are a Townsfolk, they are resurrected.
en.flavor: The process is simple. Attach the hydraulic confabulator to the modified chi matrix amplifier, add 20 CCs of pseudodorafine, keep his Z levels above 20%, and your husband will be fine. Now, all we need is a lightning strike.
